# Pull request

## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete public-facing change. Do not paste private ticket contents or internal planning links.

## Verification

List commands actually run and their results. Identify unrun checks and blockers.

## Review notes

- [ ] Relevant acceptance criteria and negative cases covered
- [ ] Compatibility, evidence uncertainty, and security considered
- [ ] Appropriate public/private documentation updated; planned and implemented behavior distinguished
- [ ] Internal plans/tickets are absent from files, PR text, logs and artifacts
- [ ] No private artifacts, credentials, or unsupported production claims

Note migrations, dependency/license changes, and remaining limitations when relevant.
